name: raven-xml
description: Completion, hovers and diagnostics for the XML interfaces of Raven; a language server for Raven Script (the <Script> of the documents and .rvs files): diagnostics, completion, go to definition, references, rename, formatting.

raven.xml.enable.description: Completion, hovers and diagnostics in the XML files of Raven.

raven.xml.files.markdownDescription: Glob patterns of XML files always treated as Raven files, whatever their root element (e.g. `**/ui/*.xml`). Others are recognized by their root: `<Window>`, `<Widgets>`, `<Widget>` or a widget of Raven.

raven.xml.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns of XML files never treated as Raven files.

raven.xml.customTags.markdownDescription: Tags registered from C with `Rxml_register_tag`: they are accepted, with any attribute.

raven.xml.diagnostics.description: Report the unknown tags and attributes, the invalid values and the mistakes of structure.

raven.script.enable.description: The language server of Raven Script: diagnostics, completion, hovers, go to definition, references, rename and formatting of the scripts (<Script> of the XML documents of Raven, .rvs files).

raven.script.functions.markdownDescription: Functions the application binds in C with `Raction_bind_with_parameters` (or `Raction_bind`, with `"()"`), so that scripts may call them: their name and their signature, as given to `Raction_bind_with_parameters` (`{ "app.save": "(path: string): bool" }`). A script can also declare them itself: `declare fn app.save(path: string): bool;`.

commands.title: Format the Scripts of the Document

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm run build
